description: Local, read-only preparation for up to eight Jobs with fresh per-Job quotes and one aggregate cap. No API requests, reservations, installations or automatic execution retries. Retain the immutable plan hash and batch key.

billing_accepted.description: true only after the user accepts the quoted minimum and billing period; budget must cover that minimum

billing_quote_id.description: Accepted source-specific billing quote from estimate_cost; expires after five minutes. Required for whole-hour sources.

command.description: bash command or script to run on the GPU

disk_gb.description: Larger system disk: 100, 200 or 500; omit for the standard disk

gpu_model.description: GPU model exactly as list_gpus returns it

max_hours.description: Hard time limit in hours (at most 24)

max_spend_usd.description: Budget for this job in USD (at most 50)

model_references.description: Pinned public model references from resolve_model_reference. Downloads into $CLOUDGPU_MODEL_DIR/<name> before the command; download time consumes the same GPU budget. No R2 cache or remote repository code execution.

outputs.description: Explicit relative output files under $CLOUDGPU_OUTPUT_DIR; no globs, symlinks, hidden or credential files. Default total limit 10 MiB, maximum 100 MiB. Only set accept_storage_charges=true after the user agrees to existing paid storage terms. Inspect output_collection after completion; the GPU is released even if saving fails.

workspace_version_id.description: Immutable Workspace version to restore before the command; requires enabled persistent storage

name: prepare_job_batch
title: Review a bounded Job batch
